unit_tips.tip: Build the study as a slim desk-and-shelf wall; keep the living open.
Full-height feature wall with hidden storage; bedroom 2 doubles as a study with a built-in desk.
Plan storage room by room; built-in TV console and window benches free floor space.
Separate dry/wet kitchen zones (per plan) suit stone counters and a display wall; (d) units’ 4.5m void suits full-height fluted or veneer feature walls.

unit_tips_note: Ideas only; check walls, services and management rules before work.

sections.heading: The Myst project facts
sections.text:
- 408 units in two 24-storey towers at 800 and 802 Upper Bukit Timah Road. Developer: CDL Aries Pte. Ltd., wholly owned by CDL. Land area approx. 179,008 sq ft. [CDL news release](https://www.cdl.com.sg/assets/en-newsroom-press-release-pdf/CDL-News-Release-The-Myst-Preview-web.pdf)
- 99-year lease from 11 May 2023. TOP obtained September 2026; expected vacant possession 31 March 2029. [CDL construction page](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/construction/)
- CDL describes a 5-minute walk to Cashew MRT (Downtown Line) and 75% of the footprint as landscaping and communal facilities. [CDL news release](https://www.cdl.com.sg/assets/en-newsroom-press-release-pdf/CDL-News-Release-The-Myst-Preview-web.pdf)

Maison is an independent interior design firm, not affiliated with CDL. Key dates are set per buyer by CDL.

sections.heading: About these concepts and plans
sections.text: The four theme pictures on this page are AI-generated style concepts by Maison for a The Myst renovation. They are not photos of an actual unit, not completed Maison projects and not surveyed layouts; layouts, fittings and views are illustrative. Each look leans on built-in carpentry, the kind of Upper Bukit Timah condo renovation Maison plans for homes near Cashew. The floor plans are the original pages 8 to 10 of [The Myst simplified brochure by CDL](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/themyst/assets/pdf/The%20Myst%20Simplified%20Brochure_Final.pdf), scaled only. They are subject to change and final survey, so confirm your own unit plan, stack and any mirroring before adapting an idea.

sections.heading: Views tips
sections.text: CDL describes “picturesque views of its lush surroundings”, but no unit’s view is guaranteed. Check your stack, floor and facing on the brochure key plan, then plan blinds, glare control and window benches around your actual outlook.

steps.title: Key collection
steps.text: Book with CDL; TOP was obtained in September 2026 (CDL construction page, updated 2 Nov 2026). Your own key date comes from CDL.

steps.title: Defects
steps.text: Check and log defects; agree rectification.

steps.title: Measure-up
steps.text: Measure-up and design freeze with Maison.

steps.title: Management approval
steps.text: Renovation deposit and hours: ask the MCST or managing agent.

steps.title: Carpentry and works
steps.text: Often about 6–10 weeks on site for a moderate carpentry scope (editorial estimate, not a guarantee).

faq.q: When did The Myst get TOP?
faq.a: CDL lists TOP obtained in September 2026; expected vacant possession date is 31 March 2029. Key dates are per buyer. [Source: CDL construction page](https://www.cdlhomes.com.sg/construction/).

faq.q: Which unit are the concepts based on?
faq.a: Type B1 2-bedroom, 63 sq m / 678 sq ft (brochure p8). They are style concepts, not your actual unit.

faq.q: What does CDL supply in the kitchen and bathrooms?
faq.a: CDL names Bosch and SMEG kitchen appliances and Hansgrohe, Geberit and Kohler bathroom brands. [Source: CDL news release](https://www.cdl.com.sg/assets/en-newsroom-press-release-pdf/CDL-News-Release-The-Myst-Preview-web.pdf).

faq.q: Where can I get the full floor plan?
faq.a: The public simplified brochure (pages 8-10) shows six types and their variants; use your own sales documents for your exact unit.

faq.q: Can I renovate right after keys?
faq.a: After defects inspection and management approval; condo rules differ from HDB rules.

cta_text: WhatsApp Maison with your unit type, key date and wish list.
